Quatre temps, chacun avec son statut : c: Four moments, each with its status: what the game shows on screen and what Rob Nelson said afterward.
Rien n’est chiffré : ni prix, ni part de: No numbers yet: no prices, no amount of health restored.
Les captures publiées avec le Trailer 2: The screenshots released with Trailer 2 show Jason with beers at a bar counter and Lucia with a cocktail by a pool; The Rusty Anchor, a beach bar in the Keys, appears in another image.
An image shows an item, not its price.
Pendant les 26 minutes, Jason et Lucia m: During the 26 minutes, Jason and Lucia eat tortilla chips in the street, stop by the Effluvia bar on a Vice Beach rooftop, go to the gym and rob gas stations wearing bandanas.
Une publicité de burger passe à la télé: A burger ad plays on the apartment TV; cans of Sprunk are on the shelves at a Xero station.
Le jour de la diffusion, VGC puis Dazed: On the day of the broadcast, VGC and then Dazed (September 6) publish what Rob Nelson, head of development, said: “Food affects Jason and Lucia’s weight, while exercising visibly builds and tones their muscles”.
Les nuits sans lit, la cavale et une beu: Nights without a bed, life on the run and a multi-day bender also show on their faces.
Famitsu : café du matin, shake et barre: Famitsu: morning coffee, protein shake and protein bar
À Famitsu, Rob Nelson cite le café du ma: To Famitsu, Rob Nelson mentions morning coffee, then the protein shake and protein bar after a workout: “Food provides buffs that strengthen your meters”.
Trois jours d’entraînement de suite font: Three days of training in a row raise health and strength.
Aucun article, aucun prix, aucun chiffre: No items, no prices and no effect numbers have been published.
